rows.ARS:
Yellow blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: MEIbosnio
rows.Origin: Bred by Michèle Meilland Richardier (France, before 2000).
rows.Bloom: Yellow and salmon-yellow. None / no fragrance. 70 to 75 petals. Average diameter 5". Very large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, in small clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, few or no prickles/thorns. Medium, semi-glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: 28" to 35" (70 to 90cm). Width: 2' to 28" (60 to 70cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .

... very double blossoms that are a blend of yellow and salmon pink.... excellent disease resistance particularly with respect to Black Spot... Height: Approximately 70 to 90 cm on average at the end of the growing season... Width: Approximately 60 to 70 cm on average at the end of the growing season... Flower Shape: cup-shaped. Diameter: approximately 12 to 13 cm on average... Fragrance: none. Lasting quality: very long on the plant. The blossoms commonly last approximately 10 days on the plant... the new variety is primarily intended to provide ornamentation outdoors... Excellent disease resistance especially with respect to Black Spot, Rust and Powdery Mildew... Hardiness: Good above approximately -10.degree. C...
